Big Picture View: For the last half of June, #ES_F built a big bull flag with resistance at 7430. This week, we finally broke it out and exploded higher.

Plan Next Week: Bulls need to run it and hold 7430 lowest (or we collapse). 7506, 7449 above there. Targets  7575, 7627, 7675 https://t.co/aJVtRgaW1i
updates.notes: 7430 named as key bull flag breakout support (new bear trigger if lost); 7449 not in morning plan, named as actionable level above 7430. 7506/7575/7627 are morning plan levels.
